The '''High Court of Bakura''' was a building located in the [[Arden Ring]] district of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="GatORW" />
